note: Adapted from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate is unknown (imago unknown), hence only the soldier and worker sections; measurements are recorded in mm as given; the synonymy list, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier antennae 14-segmented; pronotum saddle-shaped, without a notch on either the anterior or the posterior margin; head capsule strongly constricted behind the antennae. Worker dimorphic; major worker head capsule subquadrate, antennae 15-segmented.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule dark chestnut brown; antennae and femora dark brown; thorax light brown dorsally; tibiae and tarsi straw coloured; abdominal tergites brown with a smoky tinge. Head and body without long setae dorsally, hairy ventrally. Body length 5.00–5.30 mm. Head capsule pear-shaped, strongly constricted behind the antennae: head length including nasus 1.75–1.85 mm, excluding nasus 1.20–1.30 mm, maximum width 1.20–1.35 mm, width at constriction 0.80–0.90 mm, cephalic constriction index (width at constriction / maximum width) 0.66–0.72; posterior part strongly projecting, posterior projection length 0.40–0.60 mm, head projection index (projection length / head length) 0.30–0.45; in lateral view strongly incurved behind the nasus, occiput raised. Nasus conical and short (length 0.55–0.60 mm, ratio of nasus length to head length 0.42–0.52), upturned anteriorly in lateral view. Antennae long, 14-segmented; segment 3 about 2 to 2.5 times segment 2; segment 4 shorter than segment 3 and longer than segment 2. Mandibles vestigial, each with a long, dark brown, spine-like process. Pronotum saddle-shaped, without short setae (length 0.35 mm, width 0.70 mm); anterior margin convex, without a notch; posterior margin distinctly convex, without a notch. Hind tibia length 2.35–2.40 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Dimorphic. Major worker: head capsule blackish brown; antennae, thorax and femora brown; abdominal tergites pale smoky brown; sternites yellowish white. Head and body without pilosity dorsally, densely hairy ventrally. Head capsule subquadrate (length to mandibular base 1.10 mm, width 1.28 mm); mandibular suture (Y-suture) distinct. Fontanelle plate elongate, whitish. Antennae 15-segmented; segment 3 much longer than segment 2, segment 4 slightly shorter than segment 3. Postclypeus inflated, with a few short setae anteriorly; less than half as long as wide (length 0.26 mm, width 0.62 mm). Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, longer than half its width; neither margin notched. Minor worker: as the major worker but smaller, antennal segment 3 equal in length to segment 2 (longer in the major worker), anterolateral corners of the pronotum not deeply notched (deeply notched in the major worker).
